So basically it's a permutation: one person has cooking, the other chess; one has engineer, other chef; one Thai, other Canadian.

So engineer must be either at same position (impossible) or to the right of chess lover. So engineer's position > chess lover's position. So engineer is to the right of the chess lover.

2) "The person who likes cooking is somewhere to the left of the person who is thai". So cooking lover is left of Thai person. So cooking position < Thai position.
